entries.title: Healthy: CRLF, split multi-byte UTF-8, comments

entries.title: Healthy: uuid ids
entries.description: Steady events with uuid ids and resume support.

entries.title: Events written in lumps
entries.description: Events are produced every 250 ms but written to the socket 12 at a time, every 3 s: what a buffer in front of the app does.

entries.title: Healthy: events flushed as produced
entries.description: The same events, one every 250 ms, each written when produced.

entries.title: The server ends the connection every few events
entries.description: Ends the connection after ?per= events (default 3); the client resumes with Last-Event-ID. ?ignore=1 ignores it and restarts from 1.

entries.title: Healthy: one drop, a correct resume
entries.description: The connection is dropped once, half way; the client resumes after Last-Event-ID and the rest arrives.

entries.title: Resume skips ids
entries.description: Half the events, a dropped connection, then a resume that jumps three ids past the cursor (a server history that is too short).

entries.title: Healthy: resume continues after the cursor
entries.description: The same drop, resumed correctly.

entries.title: Same stream through a buffering layer
entries.description: Events are produced every 300 ms but delivered in 4096-byte blocks. Compare with f09-healthy.

entries.title: Healthy: same stream, flushed per event
entries.description: The same events, each delivered as it is produced.

entries.title: The payload format changes part way
entries.description: The first 20 orders have id, price and qty; from the 21st the price is gone and a currency is new.

entries.title: Healthy: the payload format never changes
entries.description: The same orders with one shape throughout.
